source_title: Urhobo-English Dictionary (Anthony Obakpọnọvwẹ Ukere 1986, ed. Roger Blench 2005)

notation_system.description: Ukere treats Urhobo as having two tones: High and Low, plus glides (rising/falling). Only High tone is overtly marked; unmarked vowels represent Low tone or default register.
allophonic_notes: /l/ is considered an allophone of /n/ and is absent from headwords in this dictionary.
Vowels ẹ and ọ represent open-mid /ɛ/ and /ɔ/.
